India is silently working on the world’s largest water infrastructure project – the National River Linking Project (NRLP). In this video, we explore how this ambitious plan can transform India’s fight against droughts and floods, revolutionize agriculture and hydropower, and boost freight movement and navigation across the country.
The NRLP aims to connect India’s major rivers through a vast network of canals, dams, and reservoirs – redistributing water from surplus to water-scarce regions.
